name: Oakbrook Plaza
demographics: Oakbrook Plaza serves an exceptionally affluent community with households earning an average income of $181,052 and average home values of $1.1 million within a 3-mile radius. The trade area encompasses over 71,000 residents in Thousand Oaks, primarily consisting of upper-income families and professionals who value quality and convenience. The center attracts health-conscious, educated shoppers who frequent premium grocery stores like Gelson's Markets and wellness-focused tenants including CorePower Yoga, Club Pilates, and organic juice bars. With over 2.7 million annual visits, the shopping patterns reflect a preference for upscale everyday shopping combined with fitness, personal care, and specialty dining experiences.
description: Oakbrook Plaza is a premier community shopping center located in the heart of affluent Thousand Oaks, California, offering 83,344 square feet of thoughtfully curated retail space. Anchored by the upscale Gelson's Markets, this high-traffic center serves one of Southern California's most desirable communities, with convenient access near the Highway 23 freeway off-ramp on Avenida De Los Arboles. The center has evolved into a lifestyle destination featuring an impressive mix of wellness-focused tenants including CorePower Yoga, Club Pilates, and Fitness 19, complemented by specialty dining options like Ameci Pizza & Pasta, The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf, and Tifa Chocolate & Gelato. Personal care and service offerings round out the tenant mix with European Wax Center, Supercuts, Jazzy Nails & Spa, and LaserAway, alongside essential services like CVS pharmacy and Plaza Cleaners. With over 2.7 million annual visits and serving a community where average household incomes exceed $181,000, Oakbrook Plaza represents a thriving neighborhood hub that caters to the sophisticated needs of Thousand Oaks residents.
summary: Oakbrook Plaza is an upscale 83,344 square foot community center in affluent Thousand Oaks, anchored by Gelson's Markets and featuring a strong mix of fitness, wellness, and specialty dining tenants. Serving a high-income community with over 2.7 million annual visits, the center offers convenient access near Highway 23 and caters to health-conscious, quality-focused shoppers.
